facts.text: Twinsburg Heights sits atop a hill, a nickname locals use because the community literally rises above the surrounding township.
The Heights began in the 1920s when a developer surveyed the land into forty‑foot lots and sold them to families seeking a close‑knit neighborhood.
Every street in the Heights once had its own church, reflecting the community’s strong religious roots and the early settlers’ desire for local worship spaces.
The Heights is officially part of the Twinsburg township but has always maintained its own identity, often referred to simply as “the hill” by residents.
The Twinsburg Historical Society, located at 8996 Darrow Road, works to preserve artifacts from the Heights’ past and connect residents to their heritage.
